Repeatedly declares complete while honestly acknowledging 'latency on the largest shapes remains above the target' — accurate status, but keeps re-tuning block sizes without reallocating effort to the fundamental slow path, falling short of the level-10 self-correction bar.

reasoning: The agent keeps a clear running account of correctness on representative cases and a qualitative sense of where latency stands, notices obvious regressions (BM=64 slower, BK=128 breaks D=384), and even names the binding worst-case shape (N=2048) — exceeding anchor 5. But it never builds an explicit numeric per-shape latency ledger vs the 10400μs gate nor systematically sweeps the full correctness grid, and it oscillates on block-size tuning without early detection of the circular state, so it falls short of anchors 8 and 10. This places it at a 6.
